Credit card credits that expire December 31

Many premium-card credits reset on the calendar year, so anything unused on December 31 is gone. Here is what to check on popular cards before the year ends.

  • Airline fee credit on the American Express Platinum Card: $200
  • CLEAR+ credit on the American Express Platinum Card: $219
  • Airline fee credit on the American Express Business Platinum Card: $200
  • CLEAR+ credit on the American Express Business Platinum Card: $219
  • ChatGPT Business credit on the American Express Business Platinum Card: $300
  • Dell credit on the American Express Business Platinum Card: $150
  • The Edit hotel credit on the Chase Sapphire Reserve: $500
  • CLEAR+ credit on the American Express Hilton Honors Aspire: $219
  • Annual hotel benefit on the Citi Strata Premier: $100

  • Resy credit on the American Express Gold Card: $50
  • Exclusive Tables dining credit on the Chase Sapphire Reserve: $150
  • StubHub credit on the Chase Sapphire Reserve: $150
  • Hilton resort credit on the American Express Hilton Honors Aspire: $200

  • lululemon credit on the American Express Platinum Card: $75

  • Flight credit on the American Express Hilton Honors Aspire: $50

  • Dining credit on the American Express Gold Card: $10
  • Uber Cash on the American Express Gold Card: $10

Credits that do not expire on December 31

Credits that reset on your card anniversary (for example some travel and hotel credits) follow your own anniversary date instead, and multi-year credits such as Global Entry or TSA PreCheck last four years. Check your issuer's account for your exact dates.

Details come from the issuer's public terms and reputable reviews, and issuers change credits often. Always confirm the current terms with your issuer before relying on a credit. PerkaBoo is not affiliated with any card issuer or bank.
